scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Thursday’s survey-tally practice able to rehearse anonymous webform entry for Friday’s Maple Ridge lobby table.
Emerging Need: The practice starts as paper-only and tentative; resident interest and confirmation make the live entry drill part of the planned session, but the room’s guest-network code is still missing.
Decision Context: Early planning does not justify room-tech coordination. A pre-existing workshop outline supplies the network prerequisite, request route, cutoff, and paper fallback without suggesting personal hotspots.
Consequence: Timely low-commitment coordination preserves the drill without spending or promising service changes; after the technology queue closes, the practice can still cover paper tallies only.
